outcome: Enable a reasoning consumer to understand and use source-bound knowledge through a context-appropriate perspective or bounded analogy with less avoidable cognitive effort, while preserving constraints, provenance, uncertainty, exclusions, and expiry.
scope: Generate and assess contextual framings for one named consumer, objective, context, and frozen source epoch.
exclusions: treating an analogy as literal equivalence
discarding load-bearing source constraints to make an explanation simpler
replacing source evidence or owner decisions
claiming improved cognition or productivity without measured evidence
authorizing implementation, publication, deployment, or another external effect
owner_routes: Owner of each selected knowledge source
Owner of the bounded framing objective

revision_history.change: Created the owner-directed candidate capability for contextual framings, distilled knowledge, and bounded analogies.
revision_history.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Agent Reasoning Engine product-meaning owner

challenge_route: Challenge framing meaning through CA2-ROUTE-DEFINE or CA2-ROUTE-DEFINITIONS; challenge ontology evidence through CA2-ROUTE-VALIDATE; challenge adoption, implementation, conformance, or effect claims through CA2-ROUTE-GOVERNANCE.
claim_limit: Candidate product meaning and business ontology only; no language-model modification, runtime implementation, DomainSpec admission, implementation binding, conformance, measured user outcome, or effect authority.
